input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4(b) conditions Customer's termination for convenience on payment of "early termination charges" whose quantum is left entirely to Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments, with no cap in the Agreement. That is a Customer-payable liquidated amount on termination, so the rule applies (only Customer pays; there is no service-credit or Vendor-payable LD at issue). It fails both the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer) and the fallback (early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees as the sole liquidated amount), because the charge is open-ended and could reach or exceed the remaining contract value. The exposure is aggravated by Section 13.1, under which IBM may unilaterally change the terms of Attachment A on ninety days' notice, and there is no "sole remedy" language preventing IBM from also claiming damages. Section 3.3 helpfully disapplies these charges where IBM is in breach, and Section 9.2's liability cap does not limit termination charges, which are contract charges rather than damages. Because early termination charges are an embedded part of the priced facilities-services bargain, we proposed the fallback fix rather than outright deletion: a cap at three months' charges for the terminated Services, expressed as the sole amount payable and IBM's sole remedy for termination for convenience. Separately noted but not flagged here: Section 4.2's undefined "late payment fees" (a payment-terms point) and the Section 10 carve-out at p0123 for amounts for Services that would have been rendered but for Customer's breach (a consequential-damages point).

proposal.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges and make them the sole termination amount payable by Customer
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We can accept an early termination charge, but it must be capped: our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us, and at most an early-termination fee capped at three months' charges as the sole liquidated amount. As drafted the charge is open-ended and set in Attachment A, which IBM may change unilaterally under Section 13.1.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' charges for the terminated Services (calculated using the average monthly charges payable for such Services during the twelve (12) months preceding the notice date, or, if shorter, the period since the effective date) and will be the sole amount payable by Customer, and IBM's sole remedy, in respect of such termination for convenience.
